extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from XML methods/results, figure captions, and supplementary inventory. No worker-5-owned new mechanism lane was opened.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: rPpRcys1 is supported as a membrane-disruptive antibacterial peptide in the tested bacterial systems.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: rPpRcys1 against S. aureus and V. alginolyticus mechanism assays, with broader Table 1 antibacterial activity across tested bacteria
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct assays were reported for selected bacteria rather than every Table 1 target; MD simulation remains supporting context rather than direct wet-lab proof.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The opened paper does not support a direct respiratory-chain, protease, or plasmid-DNA migration inhibition mechanism for rPpRcys1 under the tested conditions.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: S. aureus and V. alginolyticus respiratory/protease assays; plasmid DNA migration assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: The conclusion is limited to the assays and organisms reported; future intracellular targets were left open by the authors.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: MD simulation and PAMP-binding results support membrane association/bacterial surface binding context, but simulation-only quantitative coordinates were not promoted to direct mechanism values.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: PpRcys1/rPpRcys1 membrane association and LTA/PGN/LPS binding context
direct_assay_types: PAMP-binding ELISA for binding component only
mechanism_claims.limitations: MD plots and exact figure-only numeric trajectories were not extracted as exact values; they are mechanism context, not activity/toxicity endpoints.
